description: A 20 ohm load from 5 V into the collector, with the base fed through 1 kilohm from 5 V. The base current is far more than the load needs, so the transistor saturates.
derivation: Base current (5 - 1.3) / 1002 = 3.7 mA times gain 1000 would be 3.7 A, above the 0.2 A the load allows, so the part saturates: collector current (5 - 0.9) / (20 + 0.01) = 0.204898 A and the collector sits at 0.9 + 0.01 x i = 0.90205 V.
